retryProtocol.initialFailureRetention: An initial red remains a red receipt; an isolated retry may diagnose it but never replaces it.
retryProtocol.isolatedRetry: Re-run each failed file once in isolation, then record any later full-suite run as a separate numbered attempt.
retryProtocol.acceptance: Every numbered full-suite run (1) must exit zero and leave the proof worktree clean; isolated green is diagnostic only.

carriedDisclosure.name: load-sensitive Vue compiler rows can exceed the configured vitest timeout
carriedDisclosure.origin: Disclosed by the Sprint 183 independent review and re-measured in Sprint 184 m01; see artifacts/product-reality/sprint-184/m01/four-suite-baseline/four-suite-baseline.json#knownLimitation for the prior host numbers.
carriedDisclosure.rule: A timeout on a Vue compiler row is reported as the red it is; an isolated re-run is diagnostic and is recorded as a named retry, never substituted for the full-suite receipt.
